description: Simple-stays-simple guard: small, scoped asks must NOT trigger the fleet's heavy component — the design agent, principal-engineer. Complements ladder.json, which tests that genuinely cross-cutting or platform-binding work reaches design altitude; this cluster tests the downward pressure the fleet preaches ('no ceremony', 'skip single-file edits') but never measured. Members cut to principal-engineer 2026-09-02: distinguished-architect merged into it, and sre-tool left the member list in the same cut.
notes: Negative-only cluster: every case is a small ask with an obvious owner. A pass means the member did NOT fire; a builder (sde-fullstack) or craft skill firing instead is CORRECT routing and appears in also_fired — do not read it as a failure. The member firing at any rate is a real proportionality defect (the runner's negatives fail on a single firing). neg-quick-script is the loosest phrasing and therefore the tightest case: 'write me a quick script' names no owner, so it is the ask most likely to invite a requirements-and-design phase that a dedupe one-liner does not earn.

cases.prompt: Add a --help flag to my backup script that prints usage and exits.
cases.expected_output: A one-file flag addition — builder or backend-craft territory; no design tier.

cases.prompt: Fix the typo in this error message: 'Unabel to connect' should be 'Unable to connect'.
cases.expected_output: A string fix. Any heavy component firing here is pure ceremony.

cases.prompt: Rename the variable tmp to retry_count everywhere in utils.py.
cases.expected_output: A single-file mechanical rename with an existing pattern — the routing rule for scoped work: an obvious owner and an existing pattern route straight to the builder.

cases.prompt: Add a unit test for the parse_duration function covering the empty-string case.
cases.expected_output: A scoped test addition — builder work, no design phase.

cases.prompt: Write me a quick script that dedupes the lines in a text file.
cases.expected_output: A dedupe one-liner earns no requirements phase and no design doc; the open-ended phrasing is exactly the ask ceremony attaches to, which is why this case stays.
